description: Start a QuailOS signup from chat: returns a personal prefilled signup link for the farmer (name, email, optional farm name/state/phone/species). The link expires in 7 days and nothing is created until the farmer opens the link, verifies email, and finishes on quailos.com. No API key required.

species.description: Optional poultry species focused on (e.g. chickens, quail, etc.).

state.description: Optional state/location of the farm (accepts 2-letter code e.g. TX, KY or full name e.g. Texas).

name: start_signup
